lines.japanese:
「――――――！」
　バッ、とシーツをはいでベッドから飛び起きた。
　上半身がバネじかけのカラクリにでもなったみたいに、勢いよく体が起きる。
「な―――――」
　額に浮かぶ汗をぬぐう。
　なにか酷い夢で見たのか、体中がべっとりと汗をかいていた。
　特別うなされるような夢をみた覚えはない。
　……眠る前に見ていた本の影響だろうか。
　少しはイヤなものを見たような気がするけれど思い出せない。
lines.label: s284
lines.maoEnglish:
“—!”
I fling off the sheet and bolt upright. My upper body snaps up like a spring-loaded automaton.
“Wha—”
I wipe the sweat from my brow.
Whatever I dreamed must have been terrible; my whole body is drenched.
Yet I don’t remember anything nightmarish enough to leave me like this.
Maybe it was the book I read before bed.
I have a vague sense that I saw something unpleasant, but I can’t recall it.

lines.maoEnglish:
Some famous doctor said dreams are destined to be forgotten, so there is no point straining myself to remember.
―――Knock, knock.
A quiet, diffident knock at the door.
“Good morning, Master Shiki.”
“Mm—morning.”
I return the greeting and climb out of bed.
Hisui lays the clean uniform in her hands on the desk, then glides quietly back toward the door.

“I will. Thanks, as always.”

“Huh?”
Perhaps seeing Hisui let me relax, because I’ve forgotten what I was thinking about moments ago.
“This is bad. Was I always this forgetful?”

“Right. They’re gone now.”
Arcueid and Ciel.
The swarm of beasts called Nrvnqsr, and the vampire called Roa.
The whole lot of them have vanished somewhere together.

I only lost what I had newly gained.
Everything that was mine from the beginning remains exactly as it was.
